settings.name: Toggle view
settings.description: Switch between first person and third person.

settings.name: Orbit and adjustment modifier
settings.description: Hold this key to orbit with the mouse or adjust the camera with the direction keys.

settings.name: Shift left
settings.description: Move the camera left while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Shift right
settings.description: Move the camera right while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Raise camera
settings.description: Raise the camera while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Lower camera
settings.description: Lower the camera while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Move closer
settings.description: Move the camera closer while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Move farther
settings.description: Move the camera farther away while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Reset camera offsets
settings.description: Restore the default camera offsets while holding the orbit and adjustment modifier.

settings.name: Camera style
settings.description: Choose shoulder controls or a free camera with camera-relative movement.

settings.name: Smooth camera movement
settings.description: Smooth position follow and vertical movement. Mouse look, orbit, and aim stay responsive. Collision adjusts automatically whether smoothing is on or off.

settings.name: Smoothing time (ms)
settings.description: How gradually position follow and vertical movement settle when smooth camera movement is enabled. Higher values feel softer. Mouse look, orbit, and aim stay responsive.

settings.name: Horizontal camera angle (degrees)
settings.description: Rotate the camera around your character, in degrees. Zero keeps the normal shoulder view.

settings.name: Camera elevation (degrees)
settings.description: Raise or lower the camera around your character, in degrees. Positive values raise it; negative values lower it.

settings.name: Adjustment speed (%)
settings.description: How quickly the camera moves while an adjustment key is held. 100% is the normal speed.

settings.name: Orbit return time (ms)
settings.description: Time in milliseconds to return to the shoulder view after releasing orbit. 250 ms is a quarter of a second.

settings.name: Aim view
settings.description: Choose whether aiming keeps third person or temporarily switches to first person.

settings.name: Aim camera distance reduction (%)
settings.description: Moves the third-person camera closer while aiming. Zero keeps the saved distance.

settings.name: Aim magnification (%)
settings.description: Magnifies the third-person view while aiming. 100% keeps the normal field of view.

settings.name: First person during special actions
settings.description: Briefly switch to first person for takedowns, grapples, dropkicks, grabs, and pounces.
